## Calculate largest non-built-up area
Calculates the largest non-built-up area of a parcel. 

## Input data
- Pre-processed parcel dataset of 2023
- Pre-processed building datasets 2023
- Polygon dataset which separates the city of Munich in 4 parts without overlaps (needed to reduce calculation time)

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_04_final_data_2023.gpkg")
bldg_23_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/bldg_2023_04_cleaned_2021.gpkg")
subset_4parts <- st_read("./data_input/polygon_subset_4parts.gpkg")
```

## Data processing
The parcel and building datasets are split into four parts to speed up calculation time. If we run all of Munich at once, the script calculates for about 2 hours. If we split it in 4 parts it is much faster.

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_NW <- st_filter(parcels_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "NW"), .predicate = st_within)
bldg_23_NW <- st_filter(bldg_23_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "NW"), .predicate = st_within)

parcels_SW <- st_filter(parcels_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "SW"), .predicate = st_within)
bldg_23_SW <- st_filter(bldg_23_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "SW"), .predicate = st_within)

parcels_N <- st_filter(parcels_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "N"), .predicate = st_within)
bldg_23_N <- st_filter(bldg_23_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "N"), .predicate = st_within)

parcels_E <- st_filter(parcels_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "E"), .predicate = st_within)
bldg_23_E <- st_filter(bldg_23_raw, subset_4parts %>% filter(part == "E"), .predicate = st_within)
```

To calculate the variable, we create a buffer of 5 m around the buildings, which is a ruff approximation for clearances defined by law (Abstandsflächen). We then substract the building polygons from the parcel polygons. The resulting polygons are buffered by -5 m and then by +5 m to keep only core areas, which are at least 5 m wide and thus theoretically allow for the construction of a new building. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Define function 
calculate_largest_nonbuiltup <- function(bldg_data, parcel_data) {
  # Buffer buildings by 5m
  bldg_buffered <- st_buffer(
    bldg_data,
    dist = 5,
    endCapStyle = "SQUARE",
    joinStyle = "MITRE"
  )
  
  # Difference between parcels and buffered buildings
  non_builtup <- st_difference(parcel_data, st_union(bldg_buffered))
  
  # Morphological cleaning (buffer -5 then +5)
  non_builtup_clean <- non_builtup %>%
    st_buffer(dist = -5,
              endCapStyle = "SQUARE",
              joinStyle = "MITRE") %>%
    st_buffer(dist = 5,
              endCapStyle = "SQUARE",
              joinStyle = "MITRE") %>%
    mutate(largest_nonbuiltup = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
    filter(largest_nonbuiltup > 0) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(id_par_merge, largest_nonbuiltup)
  
  non_builtup_clean
}
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
non_builtup_clean_NW <- calculate_largest_nonbuiltup(bldg_23_NW, parcels_NW)
non_builtup_clean_SW <- calculate_largest_nonbuiltup(bldg_23_SW, parcels_SW)
non_builtup_clean_N <- calculate_largest_nonbuiltup(bldg_23_N, parcels_N)
non_builtup_clean_E <- calculate_largest_nonbuiltup(bldg_23_E, parcels_E)
```

### Rejoin the four parts to one dataframe
We join the parts to one dataset and link it to the original parcel data. NA values are replaced by 0, as this means that for the respective parcel no largest built-up area remains, which equals 0.

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_largestnonbuiltup <- non_builtup_clean_NW %>% 
  bind_rows(non_builtup_clean_SW) %>% 
  bind_rows(non_builtup_clean_N) %>% 
  bind_rows(non_builtup_clean_E)
  
parcels_fin <- parcels_raw %>% 
  left_join(all_largestnonbuiltup) %>% 
  mutate(largest_nonbuiltup = if_else(is.na(largest_nonbuiltup), 0, largest_nonbuiltup)) %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, largest_nonbuiltup)
```

## Output
```{r, include=FALSE}
st_write(parcels_fin, "./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_predictors_02_2023.gpkg", delete_layer = TRUE)
```

```{r end-time, echo=FALSE}
message("Knitting completed in ", round(duration, 2), " ", attr(duration, "units"))
```
